_comment: Registry of authoritative sources. Both download_datasets.py and download_datasets.ps1 read this file. Checksums in 'published_checksum' are those published by the source organisation (verified after download). Entries with 'blocked' are not downloaded; the blocker is recorded in the manifest.

sources.blocked: Download links are released only after submitting an e-mail address through the official web form (form id 'fence'). Per the protocol, the form was not bypassed or automated; LANL is excluded from mandatory experiments.

selection_rationale.ait: Predefined before any experiment: the two smallest testbeds by archive size (russellmitchell 7.1 GB, santos 10.0 GB) of the eight AIT-LDS v2.0 testbeds. Selection is by archive size only, not by content, to keep the corpus manageable.
selection_rationale.cert: r4.2 selected a priori: it is the 'dense needle' release documented to contain many instances of each scenario and several evidence channels (logon, device, file, http, email, LDAP, psychometric) while being smaller than r5/r6.
selection_rationale.botsv3: V3 selected as required by protocol (smaller than V2, heterogeneous AWS/host/network sources).
